_doc: D-003 price-source matrix (plan PD-1). Each ticker lists immutable policy versions; the roller picks the highest version whose [validFrom, validUntil] (inclusive, UTC) covers BOTH boundaries of a Window, and lists nothing when none does (honest 'paused: no signed source').
Versions become on-chain Series policy versions via scripts/deploy/set-policies.mjs (S3). Never edit an existing version: append a new one.
validUntil null = open-ended. Times are the NYSE close in UTC (16:00 ET = 20:00Z in EDT).

defaults.gapOpenAdmission: until the Gap Window's lock_at: primary.open_admission_sec = ADMIT_UNTIL_LOCK (u32::MAX), see gap._doc

_doc: S6 Monday Gap lane (session-lanes.md §1.2, D-054). No separate versions: a Gap Series (basis 1, cadence seed 604800) takes its ticker's versions below with primary.open_admission_sec = ADMIT_UNTIL_LOCK, so Friday's 16:00:00 ET print is admissible until Sunday 20:00 ET; a check keeps check_admission_sec on both boundaries. Built by policyVersions(symbol, sources, "gap") in @agari/markets/deploy.

Both prints come from the one version covering the whole Window (Friday close T → Monday open T). The 09-18 Gap is on v1 for every ticker; the 09-25 Gap is TSLA v2 (RedStone) only, QQQ/VOO have no covering version (paused: no signed source).
The Monday print uses the regular RedStone data feed id (TSLA, not TSLA---EXTENDED) at T + 0: the first regular-session print at 09:30:00 ET, not the opening cross (D-052, archived 09-14 open).

Listing set for 09-18 (Q-S6-1, stage-owner default pending the user): all nine tickers; a RedStone name lists only if every archived open 09-14..09-17 had >= 3 signers at 09:30:00 ET (MSFT/META/AMZN/GOOGL had exactly 3 on 09-14).

tokenLane._doc: S6. Switchboard Surge quotes (batched); verified xStock mints only. feedHash = sha256 of the length-delimited OracleFeed protobuf { name: agari-surge-<surgeSymbol>, jobs: [[switchboardSurgeTask { source: WEIGHTED, symbol }]], minJobResponses 1, minOracleSamples 1, maxJobRangePct 0 } (@agari/markets/prices/legacy surgeFeed; any field change is a new hash and a new version), pinned by spike (a) (D-053). Basis: TSLAx/USD per token (UI amount).
tokenLane.spike_2026-09-15: Devnet queue EYiAmGSd…, 06:37-06:43Z (Tue pre-market), 3 rounds + 1 probe: numSignatures 5 always answered with 4 distinct oracles (idx 0,1,4,6); asking 3 or 4 sometimes returned 1 fewer; 2 and 6 answered HTTP 500 (2 intermittently). Signed slot age at receipt 1-14 slots. Values within 13-28 bps of Jupiter usdPrice. Relay: request 5, send up to 4, require >= switchboard_min_oracles (3).
